title: Assassin's Creed II (Ubisoft Connect)
notes: There's no database page for AC2 yet. Related: #1282 (AoM), #1213 (Witcher 3).
issues: 1. Alt-tab (⌘Tab) in fullscreen crashes the game.** It plays fine until you switch away. The DXVK log at the crash: The game resizes its render targets to the minimized window's bogus size (a negative number misread, from the -32000 minimized position) and dies. I tried `DXVK_FORCE_WINDOWED=1`. It does force a window, but AC2 never resizes its own window: it stays at 1016×542 with the 1728×1117 backbuffer scaled into it, so it isn't usable. The game also ignores `DisplayWidth`/`DisplayHeight` in `Assassin2.ini` and uses the desktop size. I reverted it. Workaround: don't ⌘Tab while playing (save first), and turn on Do Not Disturb. **2. Laggy on the default environment settings.** The Ubisoft environment from the Connect setup had renderer `dxmt` and sync `none`. AC2 is D3D9, so DXMT didn't apply and it fell back to wined3d, and sync none made it worse. Switching the environment to **DXVK** and **msync** fixed it. **3. Launching Connect.** The Ubisoft launcher tile in Highball shows "Blocked", but Connect installs and signs in fine on x64-crossover26.3-r31 with `DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1` and `WINE_SIMULATE_WRITECOPY=1`. I added a manual pin to `Program Files (x86)/Ubisoft/Ubisoft Game Launcher/UbisoftConnect.exe`. The first sign-in attempts hit Ubisoft's "Access is temporarily restricted" bot check, which cleared after waiting.
